defaults.note: Shorter ramp than line-lead so word/phrase flips read; still no clicks.

rules: MONIKA NON-VOCAL: while Monika is the active girl theme / her vocal units, duck ALL non-vocal stems (instrumental + drums) to ×0.60 (−40%). Tribute (authority over the world). Male vocal support still under F lead.
Male is never fully removed on Monika F leads — always support undertrack.
CHARACTER DEFAULT: monika → F lead (male support under). Other girls / transitionary → both, unless unit argument overrides.
Grain is phrase by default; single WORD only when that word carries the turn (fate, true, free, apart, forever…).
Feminine / soft / intimate / confession / shy → F lead.
Assertive / fate / free / claim / dark agency / demand → M lead.
Shared vow material (together forever / never apart) → both, unless a single word inside needs a punch.
Girl theme (Sayori/Natsuki/Yuri/Monika) is UI/story color — not the same as F/M stem lead.
Times are provisional shares inside LRC line bounds until we ear-check.
Review one unit at a time. Do not dump the full list in chat.

Default lead by girl theme: monika → F (feminine lead). Male always remains as support (undertrack), never hard-muted.

Rationale (Monika): among the four she reads especially feminine; she already had a diegetic voice in-game, so a masculine lead on her lines is less motivated. Male support still present under F lead.
Overrides still allowed: justified ping-pongs, imperatives, fate/claim words, etc. can break the default when we argue them unit-by-unit.

monika_instrumental_duck.rule: During Monika vocal units, all non-vocal stems (instrumental + drums) are 40% quieter (×0.60).
monika_instrumental_duck.rationale: Tribute: Monika's authority over the world. Raised from −25% (×0.75) to −40% (×0.60) so her F lead reads clearer; drums now included (were previously unducked).
monika_instrumental_duck.applies_when: girl theme == monika (vocal time under monika units)

monika_f_lead.rule: On Monika units with lead=F, female gain is 1.10 (global lead remains 1.05).
monika_f_lead.rationale: Extra presence for Monika standout on top of non-vocal duck −40%.
